_doc: Dirty-tree attestations. Each entry says: for this specific run on a
dirty tree (identified by git_diff_sha), treat the code as if at
Schema: list of {group, log_filename, git_diff_sha, treat_as_commit, reason}.
- cfg.git_dirty=True, git_diff_sha is None     → LEGACY-DIRTY escape:
accept at face value, use cfg.git_commit. Applies to runs older
files defeat content addressing; attestation cannot vouch).
